independentSourceReview.scope: Source-only read of actual AmbientMusic.swift after implementation
independentSourceReview.findings: No concrete playlist, retry, or timer lifecycle defect found. Location identity remains separate from playlist progression; failed activation preserves the current voice with a 5-second backoff; off fades then pauses current and retires others; timer closure is weak and deinit invalidates it.

audioAcceptanceScope: Technical QA fully decodes all eight shipped AAC files. AVAudioFile verifies native codec compatibility without opening playback. No reliable perceptual listening tool was available; no subjective listening or native speaker-output pass is claimed. Root owns app UI and audio-output acceptance. No GPU work or full app build was run by the audio subtask.
